name: Kamada Kimiharu
source:
A police inspector overseeing Junko and Daisuke's investigation efforts. He and Shunsuke Utsugi previously worked together on the unsolved murders from 18 years ago, and requests the help of the Utsugi Detective Agency.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-games/Emio-The-Smiling-Man-Famicom-Detective-Club-2615498.html#Overview]Nintendo[/url]]
